raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 we were able to release prior year reserves of $149.6m (2013: $215.7m).
The reduction in reserve releases in 2014 compared to 2013 was driven by the exceptional releases seen in 2013 in the reinsurance and political risks and contingency divisions.
Overall, claims have developed favourably during 2014, with claims notifications at normalised levels.
There has been minimal exposure to natural catastrophes throughout the year, with a small exposure to Hurricane Odile seen on the property and reinsurance books.
gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions table (explicit). Prior year development figure used is the Managing Agent's narrative 'release of prior year reserves of $149.6m' (page 4) - narrative may represent net amounts after reinsurance; the statutory 'movement in prior year's provision' note was not present explicitly labelled as 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding', so narrative was used (confidence reduced). Mapping of divisional names to standard Lloyd's LOBs required judgment (Political risks & contingency and 'Specialty lines' mapped to 'Reinsurance - Specialty' / 'Treaty' for movements). All monetary amounts reported in the report's native currency (USD millions). If a stricter gross PYD from a dedicated movement note exists, that would supersede the narrative figure.
